# netbox_cables (Data Source)

Lists NetBox cable objects (`/api/dcim/cables/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_cables" "all" {}

data "netbox_cables" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "cables_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_cables.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/cables/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name; validated against the parameters of the endpoint.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `a_terminations` (Attributes List) A Terminations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--a_terminations))
- `b_terminations` (Attributes List) B Terminations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--b_terminations))
- `bundle_id` (Number) ID of the Cable Bundle (`netbox_cable_bundle`).
- `color` (String) Color. Defaults to an empty string.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) All custom field values of the object as a JSON object (`jsondecode(...)`); selection values are unwrapped to the choice value and related objects to their ID.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `label` (String) Label. Defaults to an empty string.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `length` (Number) Length. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `length_unit` (String) Length Unit. Valid values: `km`, `m`, `cm`, `mi`, `ft`, `in`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `profile` (String) Profile. Valid values: `single-1c1p`, `single-1c2p`, `single-1c4p`, `single-1c6p`, `single-1c8p`, `single-1c12p`, `single-1c16p`, `trunk-2c1p`, `trunk-2c2p`, `trunk-2c4p`, `trunk-2c4p-shuffle`, `trunk-2c6p`, `trunk-2c8p`, `trunk-2c12p`, `trunk-4c1p`, `trunk-4c2p`, `trunk-4c4p`, `trunk-4c4p-shuffle`, `trunk-4c6p`, `trunk-4c8p`, `trunk-8c4p`, `breakout-1c2p-2c1p`, `breakout-1c4p-4c1p`, `breakout-1c6p-6c1p`, `breakout-1c8p-8c1p`, `breakout-2c4p-8c1p-shuffle`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `connected`, `planned`, `decommissioning`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `type` (String) Type. Valid values: `cat3`, `cat5`, `cat5e`, `cat6`, `cat6a`, `cat7`, `cat7a`, `cat8`, `mrj21-trunk`, `dac-active`, `dac-passive`, `coaxial`, `rg-6`, `rg-8`, `rg-11`, `rg-59`, `rg-62`, `rg-213`, `lmr-100`, `lmr-200`, `lmr-400`, `mmf`, `mmf-om1`, `mmf-om2`, `mmf-om3`, `mmf-om4`, `mmf-om5`, `smf`, `smf-os1`, `smf-os2`, `aoc`, `power`, `usb`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `url` (String) Url.
